headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS

bullets_en: Hyderabad ideal for car manufacturing unit, CM tells Hyundai.
Telangana CM likens El Nino impact to COVID-19 calamity; says next 8-10 months crucial.
Chandrababu Naidu has turned Andhra Pradesh into ‘jungle raj’, says Jagan after attack on MP.
Forest Dept Introduces Online Ticketing for Kodaikanal Tourist Spots.
KTR accuses that Congress of creating drought despite Telangana’s irrigation infrastructure.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad car manufacturing unit ke liye behtareen jagah hai, CM ne Hyundai ko bataya.
Telangana CM ne El Nino asraat ko COVID-19 aafat qarar diya; kaha aglay 8-10 maheenay intehayi ahem hain.
Chandrababu Naidu ne Andhra Pradesh ko ‘jungle raj’ bana diya, MP par hamlay ke baad Jagan ka bayan.
Forest Dept ne Kodaikanal ke sayahati maqamat ke liye online ticketing shuru kar di.
KTR ka ilzam: Telangana ke irrigation nizam ke bawajood Congress ne khushksali peda kar di.
